From least bad to most bad:

(1) It is often annoyingly loud.
(2) The freezer drawer shape makes you think things will fit, but then you find the freezer won't close. (The bottom of the freezer drawer is lower than it looks from the front of the drawer.)
(3) The ice maker is slow and periodically stops working for some random period of time.
(4) Things in the back of the fridge regularly freeze.
(5) This one is strange: a layer of snowy frost regularly deposits all over everything in the top drawer of the freezer.
(6) Twice in 2.5 years the fridge has completely stopped cooling while the freezer still works. Both times, we got it working again by unplugging it, taking everything out, and letting it sit for some hours. Seems like a defrost issue?

It's a good size, it was cheap, and it is still basically functional after 2.5 years. Those are good things.

But I hate it. Do not buy this fridge.

Fridge was great while it worked. At the three year and two month mark (yes I got the three year warranty), the Main Control Board failed. The freezer still worked, but the refrigerator would not stay cool and the motor was constantly running. The repair team came to evaluate. The control board, the heater and sensor needed to be replaced. I was notified that this model (111.73022711) is made by Daewoo, and parts and not readily available. Parts (~$200) and Repair (~$250) was reasonable. The unknown availability of the part was not. Bought a new refrigerator.
Avoid this model. Research the part number and find out who REALLY put it together.

My father purchased this refrigerator, December 21, 2018. Less than a year ago, the defrost fuse and evaporated, cover and fan assembly went out. It took over six weeks to get the parts in to repair the fridge. Less than a year has gone by and the same parts have gone out again. We are again in a holding pattern waiting for parts and have been given no timeline for when they will be in. The first time the refrigerator went out, the temperature rose to 65°. This time, The temperature is holding, but the refrigerator is making some pretty loud, groaning noises. Our fear is the refrigerator will quit working again before the parts are in. This just shouldn’t happen to a fairly new refrigerator. Seers customer service is absolutely the worst and we would not recommend them to anybody.
